utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ready for the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I think I'm ready—I found a hammer and some wrenches. Did I remember to bring snacks too?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, but we haven't done the repairs yet. We need to actually fix the drive on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Hana! I've been hearing about the repair drive from a few folks. Are you planning to go?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I'm going! I'll bring the maintenance logs for that back alley pipe issue.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, the pipe issue from last month? I'm glad you're bringing the logs—that might help figure out the recurring problem.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I agree, Kira. Let's call that repair shop on 5th Street—they have all the specialty tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I guess it's worth a shot, but don't get your hopes up that they'll have those exact screws.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: You're right, but it's worth a try. If they don't have them, we'll figure something else out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Dane, are you planning to come to the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I'll be there, though I might be a little late as usual.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, see you then! Let me know if you need directions to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Eli, are you free to help out at the repair drive this Sunday? We could use some extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday? I thought it was tomorrow at 10 at the community center. Let me just check my calendar—I'm free then, so I can help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Eli! Yes, it's Sunday from 10 to 4 at the community center on Maple Street. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam! I'm gearing up for a repair drive—got some extra tools if you know anyone who needs them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That's great, Jules! I've been rounding up tools too—maybe we can pool our resources.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, Sam! Let's combine our tools and make a bigger impact.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Noah, just a quick reminder—the repair drive is this Saturday! Can I count on you to help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Spread the word? Sure, I think I can do that... wait, what exactly are we repairing again? Is it the playground thing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, the playground swing is on the list, but we're also fixing up old furniture and even talking about the community center roof. It's a mix of everything!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, can you clear this up? Faye said it's at the community center on Maple, but I've also heard the park. Which one is it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's at the community center on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Leo. That clears it up. Community center it is.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Cleo! And Sam already offered some tools from his garage, so that'll help us out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's awesome! Every bit helps. We still need more though—I'll put the word out to the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect! I'll check in with you later to see how we're doing on tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mara, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? They're fixing up old electronics and appliances at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Actually, Tess, the repair drive is this Saturday at the park, not the community center. Hope to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the park! I must've mixed that up. Thanks for letting me know, Mara!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Uli! We're meeting at the community center tomorrow at 10 to fix up the playground. Bring any tools you have!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, the community center? I'll try to be there, but I'm not sure I have many tools.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries, Uli! Even if you don't have tools, just come by and we'll figure it out together.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'll bring my wrench and gloves to the community center tomorrow at 10, if that still works?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds perfect, Rey! I'll be there with the spark plugs and lawnmowers ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, see you then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Ira, are you planning to bring anything to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I'll be bringing my old lawnmower and some tools. Got any spare screws, by chance?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I might have some in my garage. Let me check before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I... I think it was a leak near the back wall, but I'm not entirely sure.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Do you remember which room that back wall is in?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Um, I think it was the storage room... but I'm not positive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli! I'm so glad you're here. We're organizing a repair drive this Sunday at the community center on Maple Street, from 10 AM to 4 PM. Can we count on you to help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Certainly, Rosa. I'll put a notice on the bulletin board and mention it to the folks at the park. What time should I tell them to meet?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Just let them know it's Sunday from 10 AM to 4 PM. Thanks for spreading the word, Eli!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Mara, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I've been getting bits and pieces from everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yeah, it's this Saturday at 9 AM at the park! We're fixing up the playground equipment. Can you come?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds great! I'd love to help with the playground. What should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, I'll go with community center then. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Okay, see you there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I'll see you tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh yeah, I found a hammer and some wrenches in my shed. I'll bring 'em to the drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Oren! Those will come in handy. I'll add them to the tool pile—can't wait to put 'em to work fixing things up!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, glad they'll be useful! I'll see you Saturday, then.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Gus, I heard we're short on tools for the repair drive on Sunday. Do you have any extras?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I've got a bunch of spare tools I can bring. What do you need?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus! We're especially short on screws and screwdrivers. Anything you can spare would be great.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Rey, need a hand with that repair drive? I've got some tools in my garage if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam, but I think I've got it covered with my wrench and gloves for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Alright, Rey, but if anything comes up, just give a holler. I'm around.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo, are you planning to come to the repair drive this Sunday? I'm coordinating volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'll be there. Need me to bring any tools?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Leo! Maybe bring any basic tools you have, like a wrench or pliers — we've got a few hammers already.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Hana, we're meeting at the community center tomorrow at 10 to fix up the playground.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, Vik, I thought Mara mentioned the playground repair is at the park this Saturday at 9 AM. Are you sure it's tomorrow at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm sure. It's tomorrow at 10 at the community center. That's what I've been telling everyone.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey, the repair drive? I thought that was next week.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure? I thought it was this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh, I must've mixed up the dates. So it's this Saturday? Got it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So it's this Saturday at the park. What time should we be there?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think we said 9 AM, but I can double-check with the others.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good. Let me know if it changes.
